test_runs.includes: Four-GPU evaluation pool concurrency, failure cancellation, fixed scientific commands, stage barrier, and resume revalidation.

independent_review.fixed_issue: A restart between the step-2048 resume save and inference snapshot could omit the early checkpoint. Controlled runs now save the snapshot first and repair an absent snapshot from exactly that restored step before continuing; an interrupted-training equivalence test covers this.
